'''M5-BZ''' was an [[R4 astromech droid/Legends|R4 astromech droid]] member of [[D-Squad/Legends|D-Squad]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. This droid was also referred to as '''Beezee'''. He was the droid of [[Tera Sinube/Legends|Tera Sinube]]. M5-BZ was lost in [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] after he opened an airlock on board a [[Venator-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Venator''-class Star Destroyer]] while the ship was in hyperspeed.

==Biography==
When D-Squad, led by [[Colonel/Legends|Colonel]] [[Meebur Gascon/Legends|Meebur Gascon]], infiltrated a [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] ship, M5-BZ's memory banks were removed by the [[Parwan/Legends|Parwan]] doctor [[Gubacher/Legends|Gubacher]] so that Gascon could fit inside the [[Droid/Legends|droid]] and use it as his command center.

[[File:GasconM5BZ-SecretWeapons.png|thumb|left|250px|Gascon inside BZ's head.]]

While trying to open a door, M5-BZ backfired and the droid short-circuited. Gascon was forced to ride on top of [[U9-C4/Legends|U9-C4]] for most of the rest of the mission.

Although Gascon did not at first approve, [[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2]] and [[WAC-47/Legends|WAC-47]] brought the short-circuited droid back with them for repairs.

Later he was ejected into hyperspace after he opened an [[Airlock/Legends|airlock]] on board a [[Venator-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Venator''-class Star Destroyer]] called the ''[[Renown/Legends|Renown]]'' in order to destroy all of the [[Pistoeka sabotage droid/Legends|Buzz Droids]] who were attacking [[D-Squad/Legends|D-Squad]]. D-Squad would remember him as a hero for sacrificing himself to save the others.
